name: atlas-library
description: Atlas Library Management SaaS — multi-tenant study-library platform

scripts.build: npm -w packages/shared run build && npm -w apps/backend run build && npm -w apps/frontend run build
scripts.build:backend: npm -w packages/shared run build && npm -w apps/backend run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm -w packages/shared run build && npm -w apps/frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w packages/shared run typecheck && npm -w apps/backend run typecheck && npm -w apps/frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm -w apps/backend run lint && npm -w apps/frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm -w apps/backend run test && npm -w apps/frontend run test
